column1: # Golden calculations: hand-checked answers. One row per case, tab-separated:
# format = a display format id (ft-in, in-frac, ft, in, m, cm, mm, ft2, yd3, m2, num, ...)
# precision = fraction denominator for ft-in / in-frac (16 = 1/16"), decimal places otherwise
# Add rows freely: every row runs in the test suite (GoldenTests.cs) and in the app (Settings > Verify calculations).
# --- Zero inches are kept after feet (40'-0 5/16", never 40'-5/16") ---
# --- Desk-calculator percent: X + n% = X × (1 + n/100) ---
# --- Assumed units: in a sum whose first value has a unit, plain numbers take that unit (only one unit in the sum) ---
